svg.text: Plan: rounded square, R13 corners, curvature-continuous blend n = 3.4
Cover: Gorilla Glass Victus 2, 0.7 thk, 2.5D, 0.15 proud; DC chamfer 0.35×45°
1.6" AMOLED 466×466, active 28.73 sq., R5.5, on-cell touch

NMT antenna splits (PBT), 0.8 wide, x = ±12, top and bottom edges

Crown Ø6.0, 2.2 proud, 40-ridge knurl, optical rotation + push, 316L

Edge radii: back R3.0, front R2.0; back bulge 0.8; wall 1.2
SOS key 7.0×3.0, recessed 0.25 in a ridged pocket, y = −2, 2 s hold
Tether hole Ø1.8, cross-drilled through the NW corner
LORE Mount: Ø24.0 × 0.6 recess, 316L insert, 3 lugs × 4.0, 30° twist
N52 ring magnet Ø22.0/Ø14.0 × 1.0 (hidden), axially magnetised
4× pogo pad Ø1.6 @ 2.5, Au 0.76 µm, flush −0.05: V+ · D · ID · GND
1. Dimensions in mm. Scale 2:1 on A3, third-angle projection. Do not scale the print; the 3D model (models/*.glb) governs.
2. General tolerances ISO 2768-mK unless stated. Orange = critical-to-function (CTF): 100 % check at EVT.
3. Cosmetic class A: front and side faces. Class B: inside the Mount recess. No sink, flow or tool marks on class A.
4. CMF, sealing, drop and mass: id-spec.md. Internal layout: hardware/schematics/pcb-stackup.md. Generated by scripts/drawings.py from params.json rev EVT-0 / ID-A3.
